_about: Facts the previous site (Sumaniac28/awsugdelhincr) did not record, plus editorial choices for the migration. Everything with confirmed:false is a best guess that an organizer must check before launch (npm run migrate:status lists them).

iiit-delhi.name: IIIT Delhi
iiit-delhi.note: The old site gave only 'Indraprastha Institute of Information Technology Delhi (IIIT Delhi)'. Check the street address and postcode.

ambience-gurugram.name: Ambience Corporate Tower II
ambience-gurugram.note: The old site called this 'AWS Office, Gurugram' and 'Ambience Corporate Office Tower-II'. Check the tower, floor and postcode.

amazon-gurugram.name: Amazon Development Centre India, Gurugram
amazon-gurugram.note: The old site gave only the name (and 'Amazon Office, Gurugram' on the event pages). Street address and postcode are needed for Google's Event markup.

lambdatest-noida.name: LambdaTest, Noida
lambdatest-noida.note: The old site said 'LambdaTest Noida Office'. Street address and postcode are needed.

gbu-greater-noida.name: Gautam Buddha University
gbu-greater-noida.note: Check the street address and postcode.

amazon-web-services.name: Amazon Web Services
amazon-web-services.blurb: Hosts and supports community events. AWS User Group Delhi NCR is an independent, volunteer-run community.

aws-user-group-women-in-tech-india.oldName: AWS User Group Women in Tech India
aws-user-group-women-in-tech-india.name: AWS User Group Women in Tech India

acd2025.js.title: AWS Community Day Delhi NCR 2025
acd2025.js.summary: A day-long community-run conference at IIIT Delhi: 18 speakers, 11 sessions, workshops and networking for Delhi NCR's AWS community.

acd2024.js.title: AWS Community Day Delhi 2024
acd2024.js.summary: A day-long community-run conference at IIT Delhi: 17 speakers, hands-on workshops and networking for Delhi NCR's AWS community.

agenticAIData.js.title: Agentic AI with AWS
agenticAIData.js.summary: Two sessions on building autonomous AI agents and managing AWS from the command line with Q CLI, hosted at LambdaTest in Noida.

reimaginingCLI.js.title: Reimagining CLI Productivity with Amazon Q Developer
reimaginingCLI.js.summary: A hands-on session on Amazon Q Developer in the IDE and CLI: natural-language commands, live troubleshooting and fetching logs.
reimaginingCLI.js.galleryNote: The old page showed the photos of the Amazon Q workshop (astute_dev_with_Q folder). Only this event's own photo is used; add real photos in the admin.

wit.js.title: Celebrating Women in Tech: Leadership, Innovation & Growth
wit.js.summary: A celebration of women in technology at IIT Delhi: a keynote on AI in product, a career-journeys panel and talks on research and innovation.

gameDay2025.js.title: AWS Game Day: Gen AI
gameDay2025.js.summary: A hands-on Game Day where teams took on real-world generative AI challenges on AWS in a friendly competition.

astuteDev.js.title: Be an Astute Developer with Amazon Q
astuteDev.js.summary: A hands-on workshop on Amazon Q, the generative AI assistant: turning data into insights, automating tasks and building next-generation applications.

reInventRecap.js.title: re:Invent Recap Delhi NCR
reInventRecap.js.summary: The latest AWS re:Invent announcements brought to Delhi NCR, in person and by live stream, with demos of Amazon Q and generative AI tools.

innovateFaster.js.title: Innovate Faster with AWS
innovateFaster.js.summary: A student workshop at Gautam Buddha University introducing AWS, cloud fundamentals and the community that learns together.

awsSecurityHub.js.title: AWS Security Hub Workshop
awsSecurityHub.js.summary: A hands-on workshop on AWS Security Hub: threat detection, compliance and practical ways to strengthen your AWS security posture.

awsmeetup.js.title: AWS Meetup, May 2023
awsmeetup.js.summary: An in-person meetup for cloud enthusiasts and developers: five speakers, live demos and a chance to meet the Delhi NCR AWS community.

textFixes.find: Over 500 attendees connected, shared knowledge, and built lasting relationships within the AWS community.
textFixes.replace: Hundreds of attendees connected, shared knowledge, and built lasting relationships within the AWS community.
textFixes.reason: The old page said 350+ attendees in its numbers and 'over 500' in its text. Both are 'hundreds'; confirm the real figure and set it in the admin.

textFixes.find: Over 300 students attended, eager to learn, share, and grow together.
textFixes.replace: Hundreds of students attended, eager to learn, share, and grow together.
textFixes.reason: The old page said 250+ attendees in its numbers and 'over 300 students' in its text. Confirm the real figure.

consent.note: Photos and names were public on the old site, but no consent was recorded. Default is not to publish speaker photos or pages until an organizer confirms. Run the migration with --legacy-consent to record that organizers confirmed the old site's publication.
consent.legacySource: Already published on the previous awsugdelhincr site; organizers confirmed on migration
